title: SOC2 daily scratchpad - evidence & vendor reviews
content:
Quick scratchpad for SOC2 evidence tasks, vendor intake, and daily reminders. Informal notes - keep here until I move finalized items to Confluence or the evidence folder.

2026-03-01 (today)
- morning: sync with Evelyn 10:30am PT - agenda: outstanding evidence for CC6.1, vendor A re-review
- [ ] collect last 6 months of access logs for prod-s3 from infra (ask Noah to export) - note: need logs in CSV for control owner review
- [ ] confirm KMS key rotation policy doc location and copy to evidence bucket (control CC5.2)
- [x] vendor A questionnaire received 2026-02-27, initial pass complete (notes below)
- quick note: vendor A has SOC report in doc library but missing cryptography appendix; flagged in questionnaire response

Notes on Vendor A (first pass)
- Risks: lacks clear KMS integration for customer data (they use vault, need confirmation of HSM usage)
- Follow-up items: ask for key rotation schedule, HSM/Cloud KMS architecture diagram, and assertion on Bring Your Own Key support
- Owner: Priya to reach out; Slack thread: #vendor-intake (pinged Priya 2026-02-28)

Evidence list (working)
- IAM
  - [ ] IAM policy snapshots for org-master and prod projects (last 6 months) - contact: infra team (tickets: INFRA-678)
  - [ ] list of admin role assignments (current) - export from console, save CSV
- Logging / Monitoring
  - [ ] S3 access logs 6 months (prod) - need retention confirmation
  - [ ] CloudTrail aggregated export path and lifecycle policy (control CC6.2) - linked artifact: JIRA-SOC2-142
  - [x] PagerDuty rota export for 2025 Q4 - uploaded to evidence bucket 2026-02-20
- Change management
  - [ ] internal change approval spreadsheet for releases 
  - [ ] Release notes and approvals for Dedicated rollout v1.3 - ask release-eng for sign-off docs
- Data encryption
  - [ ] confirm at-rest encryption settings for customer_db (RDS/Aurora) - ask DB owners (Evelyn)
  - [ ] get KMS key IDs and rotation policy text

Meeting follow-ups
- 2026-03-02 11:00am PT: call with Priya and infra to clarify log exports. Prep: short checklist of export steps, required columns, and timezones.
- 2026-03-03 2:00pm PT: vendor A follow-up - Priya to draft email asking for KMS diagrams and SOC appendix.

Short-running TODOs / reminders
- Move finalized vendor questionnaires to shared drive evidence/2026/vendor-A after Priya confirms
- Rename files with pattern vendor-A-questionnaire-2026-02-27.pdf (consistent naming feels important)
- Add Confluence link to evidence entry once artifacts uploaded (so auditors have single source)

Random notes / scratch ideas
- Might be useful to keep a small Bash script to pull CloudTrail logs and trim columns auditors want; ask infra if they already have something similar
- Consider a quick runbook PR for retrieving S3 access logs and converting to CSV for auditors - could save time next quarter

Questions to resolve
- Do we accept vendor self-attestation for crypto if SOC report missing appendix? (Ask legal, tag: legal-review)
- For KMS rotation, what level of detail do auditors expect in the policy doc? (policy text + schedule + rotation proof?)

Links I might need to copy here later
- Confluence SOC2 control map (above)
- Evidence bucket path: gs://redwood-soc2-evidence/2026/ (need write perms)
- Ticket references: INFRA-678, JIRA-SOC2-142, LEGAL-21

End of scratchpad. Will prune and move items to Confluence/Evidence folder as they become final.

-- Olivia
